title: Callaway Golf Elyte Max Fast Individual Iron (Pitching Wedge, LH, Light Flex)
writeup: This Callaway Elyte Max Fast single iron is the left-handed pitching wedge with a graphite shaft in Light (R2/Senior) flex. Woot has it at $69.99 with only one left and a three-per-customer limit. Golf Discount lists the matching 2025 Elyte Max Fast single iron for $158.33, which is $88.34 more. Earlier Woot listings of this product said Condition New; the live offer page returned a 403 during verification so condition was not reconfirmed on that page.

comparisons.notes: Same Callaway Elyte Max Fast single iron (2025). Fetched page showed left-handed graphite Mitsubishi Vanquish 4 Senior (R2) configuration at $158.33 regular; Senior/R2 is the flex Amazon calls Light. Pitching wedge selected from set composition on the same listing.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN B0DHWK3C9N verified as Callaway Elyte Max Fast pitching wedge, left-handed, Light (R2/Senior) flex, graphite shaft, UPC 197193500957, MPN 4L112168X1006.
